Officer's narrative
Officers responded to a report of a low-speed head-on collision in Pearland, Texas. Driver 1 was traveling in the
northbound lane when the front of their vehicle made contact with the front of a vehicle operated by Driver 2, which
was southbound. Both drievrs stayed at the scene and cooperated with the investigation. Driver 1 reported neck
strain and was eavluated by responding medical personnel. The reported injury is consistent with the type and force
of this impact. Driver 2 confirmed the sequence of events as Driver 1 described it. Two independent witnesses gave
statements that matched the account, and scene photographs show damage to the front ends of both vehicles that
corresponds to the reported impact. Officers found no indication of prior damage to either vehicle. Driver 1 is listed as
a named insured on the policy covering the vehicle. Officers were unable to confirm the seating position of the
Passenger at the moment of impact, as the Passenger's account vraied between statements. No citations were
issued at the scene.
